verdict.rationale: A UI framework/compiler could plausibly expose a documented programmatic API, such as a compiler API, so this axis applies. The pack documents no such interface: the documented runes ($state, $derived, $effect) are app-authoring syntax, not a way to drive Svelte itself. The sv CLI and the MCP server are adjacent features that belong to other stories, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.
